passages.text: Vulpia fasciculata, the dune fescue, is a species of annual herb in the family Poaceae (true grasses). They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 0.24 m.

Além disso possui o ovário e o fruto com pelos na zona apical (junto ao estilete) e anteras superiores a 1 mm de comprimento. Distingue-se de V. fontqueriana pelo aspeto do calo.
